title: Spawn Family
tagline: Robinhood Chain launchpad powered by Uniswap Hooks, fundraise via MC milestones + plugins.
description: This a token launchpad designed especially for robinhood chain, it allow creators to fundraise at specific milestones/marketcaps. We're using uniswap hooks to add smaller one-sided liquidity positions on uniswap v4. This technique allow to raise capital automatically through market growth and liquidity pool mechanics rather than traditional VC rounds or direct token sales.
how_its_made:
We use Uniswap v3(one-sided liquidity positions) in a way, that allow us to raise capital for token creators form the liquidity position(this capital can be used for various purposes we call them Plugins) without directly sell the token in the Market.

We're using Uniswap Hooks(Uniswap v4) to add liquidity positions dynamically and perform various tasks(we called it Plugins) such as, airdrop to holders, lottery etc.

Substream(The graph) is our data layer.
